_comment: Reviewed descriptions of qualifying work, read only when judging a person's answer to a question about that exact requirement. Exact phrases, or a listed verb shortly before a listed object in one sentence, never fuzzy or semantic. Only status 'owner_approved' can grant Supported, and 'owner_rejected' is read by nothing. status 'source_checked' means chosen by hand and checked against the cited O*NET task; the owner hasn't signed off on them yet.
